listing.name: Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy (nxnative-aa-port)
listing.summary: An experimental nxnative-based Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy compatibility fork for Apple Silicon Mac and iOS. The project reports Court Record, 3D rendering, saving and loading at 30 FPS and 1080p, optionally 1440p; a complete collection playthrough is unconfirmed. There is no release package. Follow the Mac source build for dm/host/dmhost with the title’s GAME setting and explicit patched-module, RomFS, shader, font and save paths; the iOS script builds an IPA. Use your own base game and update 1.0.0 for title 010020D01B890000, prod.keys, patched_v65536, RomFS, shaders and save paths. Exact region and file hashes are unconfirmed. You manage rebuilding and preserving saves; compatibility across updates and other desktop platforms is unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
